title: Activity-Conditioned Single-Pair Range Breakout Candidate
purpose: Test one fixed trading mechanism that uses the RND-0060H cross-sectional dispersion result only as an activity-state gate, without inferring directional edge from that result.

state_definition.cross_sectional_dispersion: population standard deviation of the four USD-oriented returns

activity_gate.gate_rule: current cross-sectional dispersion must be strictly greater than the 45th ordered value of the immediately preceding 60 eligible market-day dispersion states
activity_gate.warmup_rule: no candidate opportunity until 60 prior eligible market days exist

pair_selection.rule: select the unique symbol with the largest absolute USD-oriented 30-minute return at 11:30 UTC

breakout_range.upper: maximum mid_high of the six bars
breakout_range.lower: minimum mid_low of the six bars

trigger_and_entry.long_trigger: 11:35 mid_close strictly greater than frozen upper range
trigger_and_entry.short_trigger: 11:35 mid_close strictly less than frozen lower range
trigger_and_entry.entry_rule: next contiguous genuine M5 bar after trigger

exit.gap_rule: if an open economic position encounters a gap, position persists and hold count advances only on genuine observations

costs: realized directly through bid/ask entry and exit prices; no synthetic spread assumption
